quotes.quote: Be the change that you wish to see in the world.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: I believe that everything happens for a reason. People change so that you can learn to let go, things go wrong so that you appreciate them when they're right, you believe lies so you eventually learn to trust no one but yourself, and sometimes good things fall apart so better things can fall together.
quotes.author: Marilyn Monroe

quotes.quote: Things change. And friends leave. Life doesn't stop for anybody.
quotes.author: Stephen Chbosky,  The Perks of Being a Wallflower

quotes.quote: It's time to get real, folks. Hope and change ain't working. Hope and change is not a solution. Hope and change is not a job.
quotes.author: Herman Cain

quotes.quote: Science fiction is any idea that occurs in the head and doesn't exist yet, but soon will, and will change everything for everybody, and nothing will ever be the same again. As soon as you have an idea that changes some small part of the world you are writing science fiction. It is always the art of the possible, never the impossible.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury

quotes.quote: This I conceive to be the chemical function of humor: to change the character of our thought.
quotes.author: Lin Yutang

quotes.quote: Forgiving does not erase the bitter past. A healed memory is not a deleted memory. Instead, forgiving what we cannot forget creates a new way to remember. We change the memory of our past into a hope for our future.
quotes.author: Lewis B. Smedes

quotes.quote: What we think determines what happens to us, so if we want to change our lives, we need to stretch our minds.
quotes.author: Wayne Dyer

quotes.quote: I hope everyone that is reading this is having a really good day. And if you are not, just know that in every new minute that passes you have an opportunity to change that.
quotes.author: Gillian Anderson

quotes.quote: The future is not Big Government. Self-serving politicians. Powerful bureaucrats. This has been tried, tested throughout history. The result has always been disaster. President Obama, your agenda is not new. It's not change, and it's not hope.
quotes.author: Rush Limbaugh

quotes.quote: I try to make a dent in people when I can. I figure people drift toward liberalism at a young age, and I always hope that they change when they see how the world really is.
quotes.author: Johnny Ramone

quotes.quote: One of the things I noticed is that people really change when they realize their expiration date is coming, and they know what it is. Most of us don't: we just hope we can live as long as we can and do as much good as we can.
quotes.author: Justin Baldoni

quotes.quote: Man needs, for his happiness, not only the enjoyment of this or that, but hope and enterprise and change.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: The art of progress is to preserve order amid change and to preserve change amid order.
quotes.author: Alfred North Whitehead

quotes.quote: Money and success don't change people; they merely amplify what is already there.
quotes.author: Will Smith

quotes.quote: Early in life I had to choose between honest arrogance and hypocritical humility. I chose the former and have seen no reason to change.
quotes.author: Frank Lloyd Wright

quotes.quote: I don't believe in the after life, although I am bringing a change of underwear.
quotes.author: Woody Allen

quotes.quote: In the long term we can hope that religion will change the nature of man and reduce conflict. But history is not encouraging in this respect. The bloodiest wars in history have been religious wars.
quotes.author: Richard M. Nixon

quotes.quote: I grew up in Cuba under a strong, military, oppressive dictatorship. So as a teenager, I found myself involved in a revolution. I remember during that time, a young, charismatic leader rose up, talking about hope and change. His name was Fidel Castro.
quotes.author: Rafael Cruz

quotes.quote: I do a lot of inspirational talks for kids, to motivate them to change their lives and give them hope.
quotes.author: Adam Beach

quotes.quote: To live is to change, and to be perfect is to have changed often.
quotes.author: John Henry Newman

quotes.quote: Whosoever desires constant success must change his conduct with the times.
quotes.author: Niccolo Machiavelli

quotes.quote: There is no reason why challenging themes and engaging stories have to be mutually exclusive - in fact, each can fuel the other. As a filmmaker, I want to entertain people first and foremost. If out of that comes a greater awareness and understanding of a time or a circumstance, then the hope is that change can happen.
quotes.author: Edward Zwick

quotes.quote: If a man like Malcolm X could change and repudiate racism, if I myself and other former Muslims can change, if young whites can change, then there is hope for America.
quotes.author: Eldridge Cleaver

quotes.quote: Hope and Change has become Divide and Conquer.
quotes.author: Marco Rubio

quotes.quote: Everyone thinks of changing the world, but no one thinks of changing himself.
quotes.author: Leo Tolstoy

quotes.quote: I don't know that love changes. People change. Circumstances change.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks

quotes.quote: I think music is the greatest art form that exists, and I think people listen to music for different reasons, and it serves different purposes. Some of it is background music, and some of it is things that might affect a person's day, if not their life, or change an attitude. The best songs are the ones that make you feel something.
quotes.author: Eddie Vedder

quotes.quote: Grief does not change you, Hazel. It reveals you.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: Never doubt that a small group of thoughtful, committed, citizens can change the world. Indeed, it is the only thing that ever has.
quotes.author: Margaret Mead

quotes.quote: For the past 33 years, I have looked in the mirror every morning and asked myself: 'If today were the last day of my life, would I want to do what I am about to do today?' And whenever the answer has been 'No' for too many days in a row, I know I need to change something.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.quote: I would be willing to do almost anything to make Art happy. I care about our friendship. The only thing I won't do is change the essence of my work.
quotes.author: Paul Simon

quotes.quote: Enjoying success requires the ability to adapt. Only by being open to change will you have a true opportunity to get the most from your talent.
quotes.author: Nolan Ryan

quotes.quote: You are educated. Your certification is in your degree. You may think of it as the ticket to the good life. Let me ask you to think of an alternative. Think of it as your ticket to change the world.
quotes.author: Tom Brokaw

quotes.quote: The optimist underestimates how difficult it is to achieve real change, believing that anything is possible and it's possible now. Only by confronting head-on the reality that all progress is going to be obstructed by vested interests and corrupted by human venality can we create realistic programmes that actually have a chance of success.
quotes.author: Julian Baggini

quotes.quote: Part of what I do and what I want to do is I want to bring art into the everyday life. If you can take ordinary just walking in the street and you're confronted by something, that might change your day - it might inspire you.
quotes.author: Kenny Scharf

quotes.quote: Candidate Obama was either exceptionally naive or willfully disingenuous when he vowed to change the way Washington works. The very promise of Hope and Change was rooted in uprooting the Washington modus operandi. But instead of rejecting it, he embraced it all - the secrecy, the closed doors, the political favors, the near-criminal negligence.
quotes.author: Reince Priebus

quotes.quote: Many people come to reinvention when life changes around them, but people come in all different stripes. I'm oriented to change.
quotes.author: Jane Pauley

quotes.quote: If you create incredible value and information for others that can change their lives - and you always stay focused on that service - the financial success will follow.
quotes.author: Brendon Burchard

quotes.quote: There are thousands of inspirational stories waiting to be told about young women who yearn for a great education. They are stories of struggle and stories of success, and they will inspire others to take action and work to change lives.
quotes.author: Soledad O'Brien

quotes.quote: One of the things I like best about 'Biggest Loser' is being around people who are trying to make the right choices. When you feel defeated about your weight and your health, like there's no hope, and you still make the choice to fight for it, to make the change happen no matter what people say or think, that's inspiring to me.
quotes.author: Alison Sweeney

quotes.quote: It's a pity that the tennis is really going down the drain. Every year it's getting worse and worse and worse. There has to be a radical change, and I hope it will be really soon.
quotes.author: Marat Safin

quotes.quote: We hope President Obama will now respect the will of the people, change course, and commit to making the changes they are demanding. To the extent he is willing to do this, we are ready to work with him.
quotes.author: John Boehner

quotes.quote: Isn't life a series of images that change as they repeat themselves?
quotes.author: Andy Warhol

quotes.quote: If I wasn't even famous or had any success, I would still wake up and put tons of make-up on, and put on a cool outfit. That's always been who I've been my whole life, so that's never gonna change. I love fashion. I love getting dressed up. I love Halloween, too.
quotes.author: Gwen Stefani

quotes.quote: You can't make people change, but the organizers of WorldFest hope that people consider being vegetarian for both moral and health reasons.
quotes.author: Grace Slick

quotes.quote: Wherever you are, be there totally. If you find your here and now intolerable and it makes you unhappy, you have three options: remove yourself from the situation, change it, or accept it totally. If you want to take responsibility for your life, you must choose one of those three options, and you must choose now. Then accept the consequences.
quotes.author: Eckhart Tolle

quotes.quote: I enjoy my life. I think I have a very good life. And I think I'm very satisfied with the direction of my career and just my lifestyle and everything like that. So I wouldn't change a single thing.
quotes.author: Macaulay Culkin

quotes.quote: Life is full of tough decisions, and nothing makes them easy. But the worst ones are really your personal koans, and tormenting ambivalence is just the sense of satori rising. Try, trust, try, and trust again, and eventually you'll feel your mind change its focus to a new level of understanding.
quotes.author: Martha Beck

quotes.quote: None of us really changes over time. We only become more fully what we are.
quotes.author: Anne Rice,  The Vampire Lestat

quotes.quote: Change is the law of life. And those who look only to the past or present are certain to miss the future.
quotes.author: John F. Kennedy

quotes.quote: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
quotes.author: Nelson Mandela

quotes.quote: Music is a total constant. That's why we have such a strong visceral connection to it, you know? Because a song can take you back instantly to a moment, or a place, or even a person. No matter what else has changed in your or the world, that one song says the same, just like that moment.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  Just Listen

quotes.quote: No one wants to die. Even people who want to go to heaven don't want to die to get there. And yet death is the destination we all share. No one has ever escaped it. And that is as it should be, because Death is very likely the single best invention of Life. It is Life's change agent. It clears out the old to make way for the new.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.quote: Desperation is the raw material of drastic change. Only those who can leave behind everything they have ever believed in can hope to escape.
quotes.author: William S. Burroughs

quotes.quote: We do not need magic to transform our world. We carry all the power we need inside ourselves already.
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling

quotes.quote: It's tragic from how far we've come from 'Hope and Change'.
quotes.author: Ted Cruz

quotes.quote: I like to change. A new lamp, a piece of art, can transform a room.
quotes.author: Madonna Ciccone

quotes.quote: The most difficult thing is the decision to act, the rest is merely tenacity. The fears are paper tigers. You can do anything you decide to do. You can act to change and control your life; and the procedure, the process is its own reward.
quotes.author: Amelia Earhart

quotes.quote: The world as we have created it is a process of our thinking. It cannot be changed without changing our thinking.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: To me, art's highest purpose is to entertain, to enlighten, to inspire, to evoke emotion and to change an audience in some way, big or small.
quotes.author: Charity Sunshine Tillemann-Dick

quotes.quote: I never change, I simply become more myself.
quotes.author: Joyce Carol Oates,  Solstice

quotes.quote: I don't know. I have incredible amounts of hope that things can change. It takes people who believe.
quotes.author: Morgan Spurlock

quotes.quote: Once you do away with the idea of people as fixed, static entities, then you see that people can change, and there is hope.
quotes.author: bell hooks

quotes.quote: Why do you go away? So that you can come back. So that you can see the place you came from with new eyes and extra colors. And the people there see you differently, too. Coming back to where you started is not the same as never leaving.
quotes.author: Terry Pratchett,  A Hat Full of Sky

quotes.quote: In a decaying society, art, if it is truthful, must also reflect decay. And unless it wants to break faith with its social function, art must show the world as changeable. And help to change it.
quotes.author: Ernst Fischer

quotes.quote: The pessimist complains about the wind; the optimist expects it to change; the realist adjusts the sails.
quotes.author: William Arthur Ward

quotes.quote: Nothing is so painful to the human mind as a great and sudden change.
quotes.author: Mary Shelley,  Frankenstein

quotes.quote: You should breathe deeply and chant, 'Money will easily and effortlessly flow into my life' as often as you can every day. Things will start to change after a month. If you believe you will be financially secure, then you are opening yourself up to change.
quotes.author: Louise L. Hay

quotes.quote: It is true that those we meet can change us, sometimes so profoundly that we are not the same afterwards, even unto our names.
quotes.author: Yann Martel,  Life of Pi

quotes.quote: Everybody talks about wanting to change things and help and fix, but ultimately all you can do is fix yourself. And that's a lot. Because if you can fix yourself, it has a ripple effect.
quotes.author: Rob Reiner

quotes.quote: Keep in mind that people change, but the past doesn't.
quotes.author: Becca Fitzpatrick,  Hush, Hush

quotes.quote: To say goodbye is to die a little.
quotes.author: Raymond Chandler,  The Long Goodbye

quotes.quote: I like to see people reunited, I like to see people run to each other, I like the kissing and the crying, I like the impatience, the stories that the mouth can't tell fast enough, the ears that aren't big enough, the eyes that can't take in all of the change, I like the hugging, the bringing together, the end of missing someone.
quotes.author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close

quotes.quote: Change can either challenge or threaten us. Your beliefs pave your way to success or block you.
quotes.author: Marsha Sinetar

quotes.quote: People change and forget to tell each other.
quotes.author: Lillian Hellman

quotes.quote: You can't stop the futureYou can't rewind the pastThe only way to learn the secret...is to press play.
quotes.author: Jay Asher,  Thirteen Reasons Why

quotes.quote: If people refuse to look at you in a new light and they can only see you for what you were, only see you for the mistakes you've made, if they don't realize that you are not your mistakes, then they have to go.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Love can change a person the way a parent can change a baby- awkwardly, and often with a great deal of mess.
quotes.author: Lemony Snicket,  Horseradish

quotes.quote: Life is a series of natural and spontaneous changes. Don't resist them; that only creates sorrow. Let reality be reality. Let things flow naturally forward in whatever way they like.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.quote: When we least expect it, life sets us a challenge to test our courage and willingness to change; at such a moment, there is no point in pretending that nothing has happened or in saying that we are not yet ready. The challenge will not wait. Life does not look back. A week is more than enough time for us to decide whether or not to accept our destiny.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  The Devil and Miss Prym

quotes.quote: Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.quote: Change will not come if we wait for some other person, or if we wait for some other time. We are the ones we've been waiting for. We are the change that we seek.
quotes.author: Barack Obama

quotes.quote: We do not need magic to transform our world. We carry all of the power we need inside ourselves already.
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling

quotes.quote: You will never change your life until you change something you do daily.
quotes.author: Mike Murdock

quotes.quote: The only way that we can live, is if we grow. The only way that we can grow is if we change. The only way that we can change is if we learn. The only way we can learn is if we are exposed. And the only way that we can become exposed is if we throw ourselves out into the open. Do it. Throw yourself.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: They always say time changes things, but you actually have to change them yourself.
quotes.author: Andy Warhol,  The Philosophy of Andy Warhol

quotes.quote: You may not be able to change a situation, but with humor you can change your attitude about it.
quotes.author: Allen Klein

quotes.quote: This is a new year. A new beginning. And things will change.
quotes.author: Taylor Swift

quotes.quote: Do I contradict myself? Very well, then, I contradict myself; I am large -- I contain multitudes.
quotes.author: Walt Whitman

quotes.quote: People do not change, they are merely revealed.
quotes.author: Anne Enright,  The Gathering

quotes.quote: For many people, myself included, the end of the world is happening all the time! It is a form of criticality that paradoxically gives us hope for change and improvement.
quotes.author: Douglas Coupland

quotes.quote: I pray because I can't help myself. I pray because I'm helpless. I pray because the need flows out of me all the time- waking and sleeping. It doesn't change God- it changes me.
quotes.author: William Nicholson,  Shadowlands

quotes.quote: The snake which cannot cast its skin has to die. As well the minds which are prevented from changing their opinions; they cease to be mind.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: ...you know that a good, long session of weeping can often make you feel better, even if your circumstances have not changed one bit.
quotes.author: Lemony Snicket,  The Bad Beginning

quotes.quote: Motherhood has most definitely changed me and my life. It's so crazy how drastic even the small details change - in such an amazing way. Even silly things, like the fact that all of my pictures on my cell phone used to be of me at photo shoots - conceited, I know! - but now every single picture on my phone is of Mason.
quotes.author: Kourtney Kardashian

quotes.quote: It's so strange how life works: You want something and you wait and wait and feel like it's taking forever to come. Then it happens and it's over and all you want to do is curl back up in that moment before things changed.
quotes.author: Lauren Oliver,  Delirium

quotes.quote: The present changes the past. Looking back you do not find what you left behind.
quotes.author: Kiran Desai,  The Inheritance of Loss

quotes.quote: We can't be afraid of change. You may feel very secure in the pond that you are in, but if you never venture out of it, you will never know that there is such a thing as an ocean, a sea. Holding onto something that is good for you now, may be the very reason why you don't have something better.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: Your lucky enough to be different, never change
quotes.author: Taylor Swift,  Taylor Swift

quotes.quote: Incredible change happens in your life when you decide to take control of what you do have power over instead of craving control over what you don't.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: You know, this is a war of ideology, a war of thoughts and of faith. And we need people to really stand for faith and trust, not hope and change.
quotes.author: Sharron Angle

quotes.quote: We are not trapped or locked up in these bones. No, no. We are free to change. And love changes us. And if we can love one another, we can break open the sky.
quotes.author: Walter Mosley,  Blue Light

quotes.quote: I have accepted fear as part of life - specifically the fear of change... I have gone ahead despite the pounding in the heart that says: turn back....
quotes.author: Erica Jong

quotes.quote: Men marry women with the hope they will never change. Women marry men with the hope they will change. Invariably they are both disappointed.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: Stepping onto a brand-new path is difficult, but not more difficult than remaining in a situation, which is not nurturing to the whole woman.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.quote: The greatness of a nation and its moral progress can be judged by the way its animals are treated.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: Pleasure to me is wonder--the unexplored, the unexpected, the thing that is hidden and the changeless thing that lurks behind superficial mutability.
quotes.author: H.P. Lovecraft

quotes.quote: Success cannot come from standstill men. Methods change and men must change with them.
quotes.author: James Cash Penney

quotes.quote: We are taught you must blame your father, your sisters, your brothers, the school, the teachers - but never blame yourself. It's never your fault. But it's always your fault, because if you wanted to change you're the one who has got to change.
quotes.author: Katharine Hepburn,  Me: Stories of My Life

quotes.quote: I think if there's something one needs to change with oneself, it doesn't have to happen in the New Year. You can do that any time you please - not that it's not a good inspirational tactic for the people that it works for.
quotes.author: Brittany Murphy

quotes.quote: Our dilemma is that we hate change and love it at the same time; what we really want is for things to remain the same but get better.
quotes.author: Sydney J. Harris

quotes.quote: The leaders who we admire who have been able to bring great change in the past - Gandhi, Martin Luther King, Nelson Mandela - they're all inspirational religious leaders and smart tacticians. It would be nice to find the Muslim Gandhi, wouldn't it?
quotes.author: Dennis C. Blair

quotes.quote: I meet people in my daily life, people who seem to experience some change and some growth on a personal level, and that gives me hope.
quotes.author: Tracy Chapman

quotes.quote: I realise that I do not change the course of history. I am an actor, I do a movie, that's the end of it. You have to realise we are just clowns for hire. After I had success it was great, at first, not to worry about money. It was on my mind when I was growing up.
quotes.author: Leonardo DiCaprio

quotes.quote: All changes, even the most longed for, have their melancholy; for what we leave behind us is a part of ourselves; we must die to one life before we can enter another.
quotes.author: Anatole France

quotes.quote: I hope that in future Congresses there will reemerge a recognition that climate change is a reality, that our policies to meet our energy needs must also deal responsibly with environmental issues, including the damage caused by greenhouse gas emissions.
quotes.author: Jeff Bingaman

quotes.quote: How would your life be different if...You stopped making negative judgmental assumptions about people you encounter? Let today be the day...You look for the good in everyone you meet and respect their journey.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Forget about the consequences of failure. Failure is only a temporary change in direction to set you straight for your next success.
quotes.author: Denis Waitley

quotes.quote: In youth, it was a way I had,To do my best to please.And change, with every passing ladTo suit his theories.But now I know the things I knowAnd do the things I do,And if you do not like me so,To hell, my love, with you.
quotes.author: Dorothy Parker,  The Complete Poems of Dorothy Parker

quotes.quote: Change the way you look at things and the things you look at change.
quotes.author: Wayne W. Dyer

quotes.quote: The only way to permanently change the temperature in the room is to reset the thermostat. In the same way, the only way to change your level of financial success 'permanently' is to reset your financial thermostat. But it is your choice whether you choose to change.
quotes.author: T. Harv Eker

quotes.quote: We are products of our past, but we don't have to be prisoners of it.
quotes.author: Rick Warren,  The Purpose Driven Life: What on Earth Am I Here for?

quotes.quote: Growing up going to Christian school and the concept that you're born a sinner and you don't really have a choice to change who you are has been hammered into my head and created the entire reason why I made art and made a band and made records called 'Antichrist Superstar.'
quotes.author: Marilyn Manson

quotes.quote: One day spent with someone you love can change everything.
quotes.author: Mitch Albom,  For One More Day

quotes.quote: Keep your best wishes, close to your heart and watch what happens
quotes.author: Tony DeLiso,  Legacy: The Power Within

quotes.quote: No matter who you are, no matter what you did, no matter where you've come from, you can always change, become a better version of yourself.
quotes.author: Madonna

quotes.quote: You cannot change what you are, only what you do.
quotes.author: Philip Pullman,  The Golden Compass

quotes.quote: I cut an inch off of every straw I see, just to make the world suck a little less.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

quotes.quote: Growing up happens when you start having things you look back on and wish you could change -Clary Fray
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Ashes

quotes.quote: Renew, release, let go. Yesterday's gone. There's nothing you can do to bring it back. You can't 'should've' done something. You can only DO something. Renew yourself. Release that attachment. Today is a new day!
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Time takes it all, whether you want it to or not.
quotes.author: Stephen King,  The Green Mile

quotes.quote: I'm unpredictable, I never know where I'm going until I get there, I'm so random, I'm always growing, learning, changing, I'm never the same person twice. But one thing you can be sure of about me; is I will always do exactly what I want to do.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: There are women who make things better... simply by showing up. There are women who make things happen. There are women who make their way. There are women who make a difference. And women who make us smile. There are women of wit and wisdom who- through strength and courage- make it through. There are women who change the world everyday... Women like you.
quotes.author: Ashley Rice

quotes.quote: The person you became with her is worth being.
quotes.author: Veronica Roth,  Allegiant

quotes.quote: Art is not supposed to change the world, to change practical things, but to change perceptions. Art can change the way we see the world. Art can create an analogy.
quotes.author: JR

quotes.quote: Forget yesterday - it has already forgotten you. Don't sweat tomorrow - you haven't even met. Instead, open your eyes and your heart to a truly precious gift - today.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: You never change things by fighting the existing reality.To change something, build a new model that makes the existing model obsolete.
quotes.author: R. Buckminster Fuller

quotes.quote: All that you touchYou Change.All that you ChangeChanges you.The only lasting truthis Change.Godis Change.
quotes.author: Octavia E. Butler

quotes.quote: We are the music-makers,And we are the dreamers of dreams,Wandering by lone sea-breakers,And sitting by desolate streams.World-losers and world-forsakers,Upon whom the pale moon gleams;Yet we are the movers and shakers,Of the world forever, it seems.
quotes.author: Arthur O'Shaughnessy,  Poems of Arthur O'Shaughnessy

quotes.quote: The philosophers have only interpreted the world, in various ways. The point, however, is to change it.[These words are also inscribed upon his grave]
quotes.author: Karl Marx,  Eleven Theses on Feuerbach

quotes.quote: I find the best way to love someone is not to change them, but instead, help them reveal the greatest version of themselves.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Dripping water hollows out stone, not through force but through persistence.
quotes.author: Ovid

quotes.quote: I love people who dress how they feel and change it depending on the day.
quotes.author: Becky G

quotes.quote: You've changed me forever. And I'll never forget you.
quotes.author: Kiera Cass,  The Elite

quotes.quote: Don't confuse poor decision-making with destiny. Own your mistakes. It's ok; we all make them. Learn from them so they can empower you!
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: If opportunity doesn't knock, build a door
quotes.author: Milton Berle

quotes.quote: I hope that through my example, such as my role on 'The West Wing,' I can help change attitudes on deafness and prove we can really do everything... except hear.
quotes.author: Marlee Matlin

quotes.quote: I don't think arrested-adolescent humor will fade. Maybe the form will change, but I guarantee its replacement will still be based in immature behavior from mature figures.
quotes.author: Adam McKay

quotes.quote: Let us remember: One book, one pen, one child, and one teacher can change the world.
quotes.author: Malala Yousafzai

quotes.quote: Let today be the day you stop being haunted by the ghost of yesterday. Holding a grudge & harboring anger/resentment is poison to the soul. Get even with people...but not those who have hurt us, forget them, instead get even with those who have helped us.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: It doesn't matter what you did or where you were...it matters where you are and what you're doing. Get out there! Sing the song in your heart and NEVER let anyone shut you up!!
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: There's always a moment when you start to fall out of love, whether it's with a person or an idea or a cause, even if it's one you only narrate to yourself years after the event: a tiny thing, a wrong word, a false note, which means that things can never be quite the same again.
quotes.author: Douglas Adams,  The Salmon of Doubt

quotes.quote: When the Islamic revolution began in 1979 under the leadership of Ayatollah Khomeini, it aroused considerable admiration in the Arab street. It presented a model of organised popular action that deposed one of the region's most tyrannical regimes. The people of the region discerned in this revolution new hope for freedom and change.
quotes.author: Wadah Khanfar

quotes.quote: The beautiful journey of today can only begin when we learn to let go of yesterday.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: If you love deeply, you're going to get hurt badly. But it's still worth it.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: I realized how truly hard it was, really, to see someone you love change right before your eyes. Not only is it scary, it throws your balance off as well.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  The Truth About Forever

quotes.quote: People who lack the clarity, courage, or determination to follow their own dreams will often find ways to discourage yours. When you change for the better, the people around you will be inspired to change also....but only after doing their best to make you stop. Live your truth and don't EVER stop.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: The only way to make sense out of change is to plunge into it, move with it, and join the dance.
quotes.author: Alan W. Watts

quotes.quote: I really think that it's disgusting that Paris is the only place where it is illegal for paps to follow you around. It actually took someone losing their life - Diana, an inspirational woman - and then it changed, but they still won't change it in London! It's horrible!
quotes.author: Cara Delevingne

quotes.quote: Life belongs to the living, and he who lives must be prepared for changes.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.quote: If you want to change the world, pick up your pen and write.
quotes.author: Martin Luther

quotes.quote: A man says a lot of things in summer he doesn't mean in winter.
quotes.author: Patricia Briggs,  Dragon Blood

quotes.quote: Every woman that finally figured out her worth, has picked up her suitcases of pride and boarded a flight to freedom, which landed in the valley of change.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: Just when I think I have learned the way to live, life changes.
quotes.author: Hugh Prather

quotes.quote: The universe doesn't give you what you ask for with your thoughts - it gives you what you demand with your actions.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: I give you this to take with you:Nothing remains as it was. If you know this, you canbegin again, with pure joy in the uprooting.

quotes.quote: I don't need a friend who changes when I change and who nods when I nod; my shadow does that much better.

quotes.quote: I've come to believe that in everyone's life, there's one undeniable moment of change, a set of circumstances that suddenly alters everything.

quotes.quote: Our ability to adapt is amazing. Our ability to change isn't quite as spectacular.

quotes.quote: Changing is what people do when they have no options left.

quotes.quote: Some people try to change the world one life at a time. Others try to change the world one death at a time. And I try to change the world one bucket full of dirt at a time.

quotes.quote: How would your life be different if...You stopped worrying about things you can't control and started focusing on the things you can? Let today be the day...You free yourself from fruitless worry, seize the day and take effective action on things you can change.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: My friends, love is better than anger. Hope is better than fear. Optimism is better than despair. So let us be loving, hopeful and optimistic. And we'll change the world.
quotes.author: Jack Layton

quotes.quote: The terrorists thought they would change my aims and stop my ambitions, but nothing changed in my life except this: weakness, fear and hopelessness died. Strength, power and courage were born.
quotes.author: Malala Yousafzai

quotes.quote: You change your life by changing your heart.
quotes.author: Max Lucado

quotes.quote: One child, one teacher, one book, one pen can change the world.
quotes.author: Malala Yousafzai

quotes.quote: Who would have guessed that four minutes could change everything?
quotes.author: Jennifer E. Smith,  The Statistical Probability of Love at First Sight

quotes.quote: Whoever loves becomes humble. Those who love have , so to speak , pawned a part of their narcissism.

quotes.author: Simone de Beauvoir

quotes.quote: I have looked in the mirror every morning and asked myself: "If today were the last day of my life, would I want to do what I am about to do today?"And whenever the answer has been "No"for too many days in a row, I know I need to change something.

quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: As you navigate through the rest of your life, be open to collaboration. Other people and other people's ideas are often better than your own. Find a group of people who challenge and inspire you, spend a lot of time with them, and it will change your life.

quotes.quote: I don't like my circle of friends, so I'm changing them to a square. Love shapes our lives, so why not shape who we love?

quotes.quote: A bend in the road is not the end of the road...Unless you fail to make the turn.

quotes.quote: People die, I think, but your relationship with them doesn't. It continues and is ever-changing.

quotes.quote: Books can be dangerous. The best ones should be labeled "This could change your life.
quotes.author: Helen Exley

quotes.quote: Entrepreneurs adopt the ways of the adept and adapt to a changing environment. Actually, entrepreneurs are more enterpreneurs, because they are forever entering into new territory.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: You couldn't erase the past. You couldn't even change it. But sometimes life offered you the opportunity to put it right.
quotes.author: Ann Brashares,  Girls In Pants: The Third Summer of the Sisterhood

quotes.quote: It's not that some people have willpower and some don't... It's that some people are ready to change and others are not.

quotes.author: Mia Love

quotes.quote: It's time to care; it's time to take responsibility; it's time to lead; it's time for a change; it's time to be true to our greatest self; it's time to stop blaming others.

quotes.quote: Life moves very fast. It rushes from Heaven to Hell in a matter of seconds.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho

quotes.quote: We would rather be ruined than changedWe would rather die in our dreadThan climb the cross of the momentAnd let our illusions die.
quotes.author: W.H. Auden,  The Age of Anxiety: A Baroque Eclogue

quotes.quote: The past can teach us, nurture us, but it cannot sustain us. The essence of life is change, and we must move ever forward or the soul will wither and die.

quotes.quote: Judging is preventing us from understanding a new truth. Free yourself from the rules of old judgments and create the space for new understanding.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: We can change our lives. We can do, have, and be exactly what we wish.
quotes.author: Tony Robbins

quotes.quote: A tiny change today brings a dramatically different tomorrow.
quotes.author: Richard Bach,  One

quotes.quote: Your greatest self has been waiting your whole life; don't make it wait any longer.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: I can't change the direction of the wind, but I can adjust my sails to always reach my destination.
quotes.author: Jimmy Dean

quotes.quote: Action and reaction, ebb and flow, trial and error, change - this is the rhythm of living. Out of our over-confidence, fear; out of our fear, clearer vision, fresh hope. And out of hope, progress.
quotes.author: Bruce Barton

quotes.quote: The greatest mistake of the movement has been trying to organize a sleeping people around specific goals. You have to wake the people up first, then you'll get action.

quotes.quote: The lesson will always repeat itself, unless you see yourself as the problem--not others.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: You read and write and sing and experience, thinking that one day these things will build the character you admire to live as. You love and lose and bleed best you can, to the extreme, hoping that one day the world will read you like the poem you want to be.
quotes.author: Charlotte Eriksson

quotes.quote: And all the lives we ever lived and all the lives to be are full of treesand changing leaves.
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf,  To the Lighthouse

quotes.quote: Act the way you'd like to be and soon you'll be the way you'd like to act.
quotes.author: Bob Dylan

quotes.quote: No matter what your history has been, your destiny is what you create today. What are you going to create?

quotes.author: Stephen Chbosky,  The Perks of Being a Wallflower

quotes.quote: The victim mindset dilutes the human potential. By not accepting personal responsibility for our circumstances, we greatly reduce our power to change them.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: We can't undo a single thing we have ever done, but we can make decisions today that propel us to the life we want and towards the healing we need.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Change your thoughts and you change your world.
quotes.author: Norman Vincent Peale

quotes.quote: You can't just wish change; you have to live the change in order for it to become a reality.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: I haven't been very impressed lately.By people,or places,or the way someone said he loved me and then slowly changed his mind.
quotes.author: Charlotte Eriksson

quotes.quote: Are you going to allow the world around you to change while you remain stagnant? Make this the time you throw away old habits that have hindered your happiness and success and finally allow your greatest self to flourish.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: If you want to be a new man you have to stay in new places, and do new things, with people who never knew you before. If you go back to the same old ways, what else can you be but the same old person?
quotes.author: Joe Abercrombie,  Last Argument of Kings

quotes.quote: People who can change and change again are so much more reliable and happier than those who can't
quotes.author: Stephen Fry,  Moab Is My Washpot

quotes.quote: I wanted the past to go away, I wanted to leave it, like another country; I wanted my life to close, and open like a hinge, like a wing, like the part of the song where it falls down over the rocks: an explosion, a discovery; I wanted to hurry into the work of my life; I wanted to know,whoever I was, I wasalive for a little while.
quotes.author: Mary Oliver,  Dream Work

quotes.quote: Once your mindset changes, everything on the outside will change along with it.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: I am a fashion person, and fashion is not only about clothes -- it's about all kinds of change
quotes.author: Karl Lagerfeld

quotes.quote: Nothing in the world is permanent, and we're foolish when we ask anything to last, but surely we're still more foolish not to take delight in it while we have it. If change is of the essence of existence one would have thought it only sensible to make it the premise of our philosophy.

quotes.quote: How would your life be different if...You didn't allow yourself to be defined by your past? Let today be the day...You stop letting your history interfere with your destiny and awaken to the opportunity to release your greatest self.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: No matter what people tell you, words and ideas can change the world.
quotes.author: Robin Williams

quotes.quote: I wanted change and excitement and to shoot off in all directions myself, like the colored arrows from a Fourth of July rocket.
quotes.author: Sylvia Plath

quotes.quote: Do not dilute the truth of your potential. We often convince ourselves that we cannot change, that we cannot overcome the circumstances of our lives. That is simply not true. You have been blessed with immeasurable power to make positive changes in your life. But you can't just wish it, you can't just hope it, you can't just want it... you have to LIVE it, BE it, DO it.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: I am not the moon orbiting around your planet; I am the sun that will burn through your frozen mind.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: A writer used to live life like Julius Seizure: I came, I saw, I queried. Now you can take control of your consciousness and self-publish.

quotes.quote: You've been given the innate power to shape your life...but you cannot just speak change, you have to LIVE change. Intent paired with action builds the bridge to success. You can't just want it; you have to do it, live it...BE it! Success isn't something you have, it's something you DO!
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: Coin a new word and hear it jingle in your pocket with all your other change. My love for you is sofacouchsitsitting, so you'd better buckle up.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Don't change your mind just because people are offended; change your mind if you're wrong.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Diotima, Battery, Electric Personality

quotes.quote: Caelum non animum mutant qui trans mare currunt.(They change their sky, not their soul, who rush across the sea.)
quotes.author: Horace,  The Odes of Horace: Bilingual Edition

quotes.quote: Life is neither static nor unchanging. With no individuality, there can be no change, no adaptation and, in an inherently changing world, any species unable to adapt is also doomed.
quotes.author: Jean M. Auel

quotes.quote: It's not about perfect. It's about effort. And when you bring that effort every single day, that's where transformation happens. That's how change occurs.
quotes.author: Jillian Michaels

quotes.quote: I change the world, the world changes me.
quotes.author: Libba Bray

quotes.quote: Sometimes the door closes on a relationship, not because we failed but because something bigger than us says this no longer fits our life. So, lock the door, shed a tear, turn around and look for the new door that's opened. It's a sign that you're no longer that person you were, it's time to change into who you are. It's going to be okay.
quotes.author: Lee Goff

quotes.quote: Sometimes, being true to yourself means changing your mind. Self changes, and you follow.
quotes.author: Vera Nazarian,  The Perpetual Calendar of Inspiration

quotes.quote: How would your life be different if...You stopped focusing on what you didn't want and started focusing on what you do want? Let today be the day...You establish a clear intent, make a plan, and take actions towards your intent.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Simplify your life. You don't grow spiritual, you shrink spiritual.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: The aching in my chest isn't because I miss you,it's realizing that you have become someone I no longer know,your fears, your 4 am thoughts, your achievements,are things I no longer have an equivalent to.Who we were and who we are are four different people, and the me from now doesn't relate to the me from then, let alone to the you from now.-Tanzy Sayadi and Jarod Kintz
quotes.author: Tanzy Sayadi,  liQUID PROse QUOtes

quotes.quote: The only person who is spiritually smart is the one who has learned how to learn, unlearn, and change directions instantly, and start all over again, if your soul calls for it.

quotes.quote: Your life begins to change the day you take responsibility for it.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Who we were and who we are are four different people, and the me from now doesn't relate to the me from then, let alone to the you from now.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: We are all butterflies. Earth is our chrysalis.
quotes.author: LeeAnn Taylor

quotes.quote: I fall in love with you four times a year: winter, spring, summer, and fall. The leaves may change, but how I feel about you does not.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Love without hope will not survive.Love without faith changes nothing.Love gives power to hope and faith.
quotes.author: Toba Beta,  My Ancestor Was an Ancient Astronaut

quotes.quote: It is easier to change a man's religion than to change his diet.
quotes.author: Margaret Mead

quotes.quote: Learn to adapt. Things change, circumstances change. Adjust yourself and your efforts to what it is presented to you so you can respond accordingly. Never see change as a threat, because it can be an opportunity to learn, to grow, evolve and become a better person.
quotes.author: Rodolfo Costa,  Advice My Parents Gave Me: and Other Lessons I Learned from My Mistakes

quotes.quote: Never question the power of one! Throughout history it has been the actions of only one person who has in inspired the movement of change.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Stop just cheering for others who are living their visions. Commit yourself to your own success and follow the steps required to achieve it.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: The power to change your life lies in the simplest of steps.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: Bending beats breaking.
quotes.author: Betty Greene

quotes.quote: Well and good if all things change, O Lord God, provided I am rooted in You.
quotes.author: Juan de la Cruz

quotes.quote: Interrupt your thoughts of "I should", with your action of doing.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: I don't know the kind of person I'll be tomorrow, but I'll be able to look back on yesterday and ask 'What was that guy's problem?' The future is full of condescending jerks.
quotes.author: Bauvard,  Some Inspiration for the Overenthusiastic

quotes.quote: It isn't the happy ending Ingrid and I had dreamed up, but it's all a part of what I'm working through. The way life changes. The way people and things disappear. Then appear, unexpectedly, and hold you close.
quotes.author: Nina LaCour,  Hold Still

quotes.quote: Everywhere we shine death and life burn into something new...
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  Elemental: The Power of Illuminated Love

quotes.quote: Change is in the air. This change reminds us that we are made and beautifully sculpted by the same power that orchestrates the change of season. Let this be the season you embrace and align yourself with this change.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: If you're reading these words, perhaps it's because something has kicked open the door for you, and you're ready to embrace change. It isn't enough to appreciate change from afar, or only in the abstract, or as something that can happen to other people but not to you. We need to create change for ourselves, in a workable way, as part of our everyday lives.
quotes.author: Sharon Salzberg,  The Power of Meditation: A 28-Day Programme for Real Happiness

quotes.quote: Life is about moving, it's about change. And when things stop doing that they're dead.
quotes.author: Twyla Tharp

quotes.quote: It is a time of change,'' Sazed said. ''Perhaps it is also time to learn of other truths, other ways.
quotes.author: Brandon Sanderson,  The Well of Ascension

quotes.quote: As the earth dies your spirit will bloom; as the world fades your soul will rise and glisten. Amongst the dehydrated crevices of a desert earth you will stumble upon your diamonds; in between the dry skulls and cracked bones you will find your sapphires.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: For in spite of itself any movement that thinks and acts in terms of an 'ism becomes so involved in reaction against other 'isms that it is unwittingly controlled by them. For it then forms its principles by reaction against them instead of by a comprehensive, constructive survey of actual needs, problems, and possibilities.
quotes.author: John Dewey

quotes.quote: No boundary or barrier surrounds the heart of a person that loves their self and others.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: Fashion is about going ahead, not about memory.
quotes.author: Karl Lagerfeld

quotes.author: Antoine Lavoisier,  TraitÃ© Ã©lÃ©mentaire de chimie

quotes.quote: I knew that I had been partially right in the storeroom above the bar on Christmas Day. Whoever I had become had to die.
quotes.author: Craig Ferguson,  American on Purpose: The Improbable Adventures of an Unlikely Patriot

quotes.quote: Never run from the truth. It is always there; it never changes - save your energy.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: People can change anything they want to, and that means everything in the world.
quotes.author: Joe Strummer

quotes.quote: Because I don't think God trusts just anybody with so much heartache. The world has not yet seen what God can do with a man who gives both halves of a broken heart to him. And I don't doubt that a man like that can change the world...or at least a little part of it.
quotes.author: Chris Fabry,  Almost Heaven

quotes.quote: Flexibility requires an open mind and a welcoming of new alternatives.
quotes.author: Deborah Day

quotes.quote: Fair as the moon and joyful as the light;Tot wan with waiting, not with sorrow dim; Not as she is, but was when hope shone bright;Not as she is, but as she fills his dreams.
quotes.author: Christina Rossetti

quotes.quote: We live in a world that is beyond our control, and life is in a constant flux of change. So we have a decision to make: keep trying to control a storm that is not going to go away or start learning how to live within the rain.
quotes.author: Glenn Pemberton,  Hurting with God

quotes.quote: In my darkest night,when the moon was coveredand I roamed through wreckage,a nimbus-clouded voicedirected me:'Live in the layers,not on the litter.'Though I lack the artto decipher it,no doubt the next chapterin my book of transformationsis already written.I am not done with my changes.

quotes.quote: Believe something and the Universe is on its way to being changed. Because you've changed, by believing. Once you've changed, other things start to follow. Isn't that the way it works?

quotes.quote: If you had hope, maybe you could find a way to make things change,. Because if you thought about it, there were so many reasons to try.

quotes.quote: Why wait? So precious is this life--this gift--this temporary blindness. Burn and drown and embrace the false dark, then grasp the unthinkable height of resulting joy. For in the end, in the light of truth when the flesh is cast off, there is nothing but this.

quotes.quote: But there was a special kind of gift that came with embracing the chaos, even if I cursed most of the way. You can begin to focus on what you want to achieve and make it happen
quotes.author: Amaka Imani Nkosazana
